project_name: TNL Studio — Telecommunication Network Laboratory ITS Surabaya
archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & TECHNICAL EARTHY (Precision Engineering + Academic Prestige)
context: Public academic laboratory website & recruitment portal + Custom block-based CMS (TNL Studio) for student lab assistants at Department of Electrical Engineering, ITS Surabaya (Gedung B-301)

layout_and_spacing.card_styling: rounded-[15px] bg-white border border-[#eaeaec] shadow-[0_20px_80px_rgba(193,199,212,0.25)] p-6 sm:p-8 transition-transform duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1
layout_and_spacing.button_styling: rounded-[6px] min-h-[50px] px-6 font-medium inline-flex items-center justify-center transition-colors duration-150 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#43594A] focus:ring-offset-2
layout_and_spacing.input_styling: h-[50px] rounded-[6px] border border-[#eaeaec] bg-white px-4 text-base text-[#111518] focus:border-[#43594A] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#a8977b] focus:outline-none
layout_and_spacing.section_heading_rule: flex items-center gap-3 mb-8 sm:mb-10; Left accent bar: w-1.5 h-8 bg-[#43594A] rounded-full; optional tan count chip: px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold bg-[#a8977b]/15 text-[#7f715c] rounded-full

entry_surfaces./: split hero with B-301 room badge, accent title, intro copy and dual CTAs on dark gradient left, live server rack image right
entry_surfaces./member: Head of Laboratory featured banner in dark gradient with Scholar/SINTA badges, followed by 5-col faculty and batch-tabbed assistant directory
entry_surfaces./activity: split activity overview with R&D project clusters, practicum modules, and alternating assistant life timeline
entry_surfaces./news: three-column featured article grid with category filter tabs and search bar
entry_surfaces./contact: split contact layout with icon-tile laboratory info (Gedung B-301 ITS) left, interactive inquiry form right
entry_surfaces./publications: indexed research repository table with filter by year, track (5G/6G, IoT, SDN, Cloud), and direct Scopus/PDF download links
entry_surfaces./admin/login: branded split login — TNL Studio maintainer positioning on dark green gradient left, secure auth form on white card right
entry_surfaces./admin: dense command-center CMS dashboard with quick stats, page builder workbench, media manager, and event registrar pipeline

public_routes_structure.name: Home
sections: Announcement popup (dismissible modal/banner for urgent lab recruitment/events)
Sticky white navigation with ITS logo, Lab badge, menu dropdowns, language switch (EN/ID), 'Join Us' CTA
Hero section: 'B-301 Gedung B EE' badge, main heading with tan accent word, 2 CTAs ('Explore Research', 'Join Assistant Recruitment'), telecommunication lab server rack image
Live stats counter strip: Lecturers, Active Assistants, Research Tracks, B-301 Lab Room Capacity
About TNL section: Left-accent heading + 4 icon-tile grid (Network Virtualization, 5G/6G Testbed, IoT & Smart Systems, Cloud Networking)
Research Focus cards: Numbered cards '01' to '05' with left tan accent border + dark gradient 'See all research' link card
Fields of Study interactive carousel with navigation arrows and dot indicators
Trio of Quick-Link action cards: Practicum Modules, Lab Assistant Recruitment, Industry Training
Latest News & Research Highlights: 3-column card grid with date chips and read-more triggers
Partner & Accreditation Logo Strip: ITS Surabaya, IEEE Communications Society, Telkom Indonesia, APJII, Kominfo
Footer on deep black (#111518) with 4 columns (About, Navigation, Research Tracks, Contact/Location) + bottom copyright and terms

public_routes_structure.name: Members & Faculty
components: Dark gradient banner for Head of Laboratory (Dr. Ir. Wirawan, M.Eng. / Prof. Dev) with Scholar, SINTA, Scopus links, email, bio
5-column faculty & researcher grid with role badges, office info, research domains
Laboratory Assistant directory with Batch tabs (e.g. Batch 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026)
Role-based division grouping (Coordinator, Secretary/Treasurer, Network Division, Cloud & IoT Division)
Distinct role pill badges (dark green for Coordinator, tan-dark for Head, gray for Staff)
Assistant profile detail modal (HD photo, role, division, expertise tags, public email, CV download link, LinkedIn/GitHub)

public_routes_structure.name: Laboratory Activities & Projects
components: R&D Projects: Research cluster cards, active testbeds, live prototype demos, grant sponsors
Practicum: Academic telecommunication network lab modules, schedule download, assistant contact
Events & Workshops: Event cards with auto-status badge (Open/Upcoming/Past), poster carousel, date/location tiles, WhatsApp contact person chips, registration auto-closing
Assistant Activity: Alternating image/text rows with large faded numerals (01, 02, 03), date chip, category chip (Social/Internal/Academic), photo gallery with 1/N counter badge

public_routes_structure.name: News & Publications
components: Search input + Category filter chips (Announcements, Research Breakthroughs, Student Achievements, Workshops)
3-column article cards with thumbnail, publish date, read time, category tag, excerpt
Article detail page view with breadcrumbs, reading progress bar, author card, related news

public_routes_structure.name: Contact & Visit
components: Icon-box information cards: Room B-301 Gedung B, Department of Electrical Engineering, ITS Sukolilo, Surabaya 60111
Direct email (elits@ee.its.ac.id / tnl@ee.its.ac.id) and phone extensions
Interactive Inquiry & Lab Visit Reservation Form with validation

features.name: Block-Based Page Builder
features.concept: Gutenberg/Notion-style structured blocks with drag-and-drop reordering, duplicate, visibility toggling, draft vs published, and revision restore
block_library: Image & Banner with Alt text enforcement
Alternating Activity Rows with Large Numeral

features.name: Theme Token Customizer
features.description: Visual theme editor allowing student lab assistants to preview and adjust brand colors, typography sizes, card radii, and button styles with draft/published state and one-click 'Reset to TNL Default' button

features.name: Media Library
features.description: Folder hierarchy, bulk image uploader, mandatory alt text enforcement, 'used-in-N-pages' reference counter, and copy CDN URL

features.name: Event & Workshop Registrar
features.description: Pipeline for student registrations, filter by status (Pending/Approved/Attended), bulk email trigger, CSV/Excel export, and QR ticket verification

features.name: Lab Maintainer Guide
features.description: Built-in interactive onboarding guide for incoming student lab assistant batches (SOP for updating news, adding members, launching recruitment)

motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.15s ease
motion_and_interactions.tabs_indicator: motion layout transition with soft spring physics

accessibility_requirements.keyboard_navigation: Visible 2px focus ring on all focusable controls with color #43594A or #a8977b
accessibility_requirements.alt_text_rule: Every image element MUST have non-empty, descriptive alt text
accessibility_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and status cards MUST have kebab-case data-testid tags (e.g. data-testid='hero-join-us-button', data-testid='member-batch-2025-tab')

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts: FastAPI backend + React 19 / Vite / Tailwind v4 frontend at /app/frontend.
Implement both the public academic marketing website and the custom CMS '/admin' (TNL Studio) seamlessly.
Ensure the EN/ID bilingual toggle switches UI strings and seeded content without page refresh.
Ensure all theme tokens (brand black #111518, tan #a8977b, dark green #43594A, surface #f4f4f5, border #eaeaec) are defined in index.css and accessible dynamically.
Deliver the block-based page builder in the admin dashboard with functional drag, reorder, visibility toggle, and live preview.

Include pre-seeded realistic data for ITS Electrical Engineering TNL: Lab Head (Dr. Wirawan / Prof. Dev), 5 faculty lecturers, 12 active student assistants across batches 2024-2026, research tracks (5G/6G, SDN, IoT, Cloud), practicum modules, and workshop events with live registration counters.
Always maintain WCAG AA contrast by using #7f715c for small tan text on light backgrounds and #a8977b on dark backgrounds.
